branch: N: subject lowercase shown in the outfmt 0 Sbjct rows (-lcase_masking) with a range
notes: NCBI selects the masks to display with s_SeqIntervalToSeqLocInfo: a FULL-record mask interval is returned only if it intersects (TSeqRange, closed) one of the HSP ranges [hsp.subject.offset, hsp.subject.end] given in INTERVAL coordinates (union over all HSPs of the subject); the returned masks are drawn in full coordinates. So with from0>0 a mask that overlaps the alignment in the file can be dropped and the Sbjct row shows no lowercase (oracle: mask 2000-2200, hit 1901-2300: lowercase shown with no range and with range 1-2500; none with 1001-2500 and 1901-2500). LOSAT-before marks every mask of the cut subject that overlaps the row (right positions, wrong selection). Port: keep the full-record masks per subject, apply the NCBI intersection test with interval-coordinate HSP offsets and draw the selected masks at full coordinates. Visible only in outfmt 0 (and the hit records of the web ABI).
